definitions: A genus of flowering plants in the Adoxaceae family, native to temperate to subtropical regions of the world.
A plant belonging to the genus Sambucus, typically a shrub or small tree with clusters of small white or cream-colored flowers followed by bunches of small red, blue, or black berries.
examples: The garden featured several varieties of Sambucus.
Sambucus nigra is a common species found in hedgerows.
The berries of some Sambucus species are edible.
